Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameEventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements GameEventListener
JavaFX controller for the main game screen.

Implements GameEventListener to receive game events from the TurnManager running on a background thread. All UI mutations are dispatched via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable).

Responsibilities:

  • Initialising the GameEngine and TurnManager on startup.
  • Rendering player hands (face-up for the human, face-down for machines).
  • Displaying the top card and cumulative sum with colour-coded urgency.
  • Forwarding human card-click events to the TurnManager.
  • Logging game events to the side panel.
  • Transitioning to the EndStage when the game ends.
